title: 第1496章 神念所化的秦延军第1495章 今天巨变兄妹被围
content_zh:
第1496章神念所化的秦延军
秦思宇心中一沉，对方显然是冲着他们，或者说冲着莲子来的。
而且，听对方的口气，似乎对父亲的情况有所了解。难道父亲的死，并非意外？
“我父亲如何，与尔等无关！”秦思宇怒喝，神力鼓荡，“想要动手，先问问我手中的剑！”
“就凭你？一个中期古神王？”黑袍男子嗤笑一声，“秦延军都自身难保了，你以为你能护得住什么？识相的，把那枚莲子交出来，或许还能给你们留个全尸！”
“痴心妄想！”秦思浩怒喝着，率先挺枪刺出。
“不知死活！”黑袍男子眼中杀机一闪，“给我拿下！活要见人，死要见尸，还有那莲子！”
四名古神王境中期的随从立刻扑了上来，战斗瞬间爆发。
秦思宇以一敌二，剑光如龙，勉强支撑。
秦思浩对战一名中期神王，剑法刚猛，却也渐渐落入下风。
秦思涵虽然也是初期古神王，但实战经验相对匮乏，面对一名中期古神王的攻击，显得有些捉襟见肘。
“思涵，保护好自己和莲子！”秦思宇见状，心急如焚，猛地爆发神力，逼退两名对手，同时对秦思涵喊道。
“哥！”秦思涵眼中闪过一丝焦急，她知道自己不能成为拖累。她深吸一口气，储物戒中飞出一柄玉箫，箫声悠扬，却带着一股奇异的精神力量，干扰着对手的神念。
同时，她的身形变得飘忽不定，显然修炼了某种高明的身法。
然而，实力的差距是明显的。秦思浩肩头中了一掌，鲜血瞬间染红了衣衫，闷哼一声，气息有些紊乱。
“思浩！”秦思宇目眦欲裂，想要回援，却被两名对手死死缠住。
黑袍男子站在一旁，冷漠地看着这一切，如同猫捉老鼠般，享受着猎物挣扎的快感。
“秦延军啊秦延军，你一生英雄，最终却落得家破人亡的下场，真是可悲可叹。你的莲子，就由我‘黑煞王’来替你保管吧！”
“黑煞王？！”秦思宇心中剧震，这个名字他听过，是二十八重天一个臭名昭著的杀手组织头目，心狠手辣，实力强大。父亲怎么会惹上这样的人物？
就在这危急关头，秦思涵突然做出了一个让所有人都意想不到的举动。

她猛地将储物戒掷向空中，同时口中念念有词，一道微弱但精纯的光芒从她体内散发出来，与储物戒产生了某种联系。
“想抢莲子？做梦！”秦思涵眼中闪过一丝决绝。
黑煞王脸色一变：“不好！她要毁了莲子！”他身影一闪，如鬼魅般扑向那枚储物戒，他此行的目的就是莲子，绝不能让它被毁。
秦思宇和秦思浩也抓住了这稍纵即逝的机会，全力爆发，逼退了对手。
然而，黑煞的速度实在太快，眼看就要抓住储物戒。
就在这时，异变陡生！
一道仿佛来自九天之外而威严的声音，如同九天惊雷，骤然在天地间响起：
“黑煞小儿，也敢动老夫的东西？”
content_en:
Chapter 1496 Qin Yanjun transformed by divine thoughts
Qin Siyu's heart sank. The other party was obviously coming for them, or for Lianzi.
Moreover, from the tone of the other party, it seemed that he knew something about his father's situation. Could it be that his father's death was not an accident?
"What happens to my father has nothing to do with you!" Qin Siyu shouted angrily, surging with divine power, "If you want to take action, ask me about the sword in my hand first!"
"Only you? A mid-term ancient god king?" The black-robed man sneered, "Qin Yanjun can't even protect himself, what do you think you can protect? If you are wise, hand over the lotus seed, and maybe I can leave you with a whole body!"
"Wishful thinking!" Qin Sihao shouted angrily and took the lead in thrusting out his spear.
"I don't know whether to live or die!" The black-robed man's eyes flashed with murderous intent, "Get it! If you want to live, you will see the person, if you die, you will see the corpse, and the lotus seeds!"
Four followers who were in the middle stage of the Ancient God King realm immediately rushed forward, and the battle broke out instantly.
Qin Siyu fought one against two, his sword shining like a dragon, barely holding on.
Qin Sihao fought against a mid-stage god king. His swordsmanship was fierce, but he gradually fell into a disadvantage.
Although Qin Sihan is also an early-stage Ancient God King, he has relatively little actual combat experience. Facing the attack of a mid-stage Ancient God King, he seems a little stretched.
"Sihan, protect yourself and Lianzi!" Upon seeing this, Qin Siyu was so anxious that he suddenly burst out with divine power, forced back the two opponents, and shouted to Qin Sihan at the same time.
"Brother!" Qin Sihan's eyes flashed with anxiety, and she knew she couldn't be a drag. She took a deep breath, and a jade flute flew out of the storage ring. The flute had a melodious sound, but it carried a strange spiritual power that interfered with the opponent's spiritual thoughts.
At the same time, her figure became erratic, and she had obviously practiced some kind of superb movement technique.
However, the gap in strength is obvious. Qin Sihao was hit with a palm on his shoulder, and the blood instantly dyed his clothes red. He groaned and his breath was somewhat disordered.
"Sihao!" Qin Siyu's eyes were splitting, and he wanted to come back for help, but he was tightly entangled by two opponents.
The man in black robe stood aside, watching all this indifferently, like a cat and a mouse, enjoying the pleasure of the prey's struggle.
"Qin Yanjun, Qin Yanjun, you have been a hero all your life, but in the end you ended up with your family ruined. It is really sad. Let me, the Black Evil King, take care of your lotus seeds for you!"
"Black Evil King?!" Qin Siyu was shocked. He had heard this name before. He was the leader of a notorious killer organization in the 28th Heaven. He was ruthless and powerful. How could my father get into trouble with such a person?
At this critical moment, Qin Sihan suddenly made a move that surprised everyone.
She threw the storage ring into the air fiercely, and at the same time muttered something in her mouth, a weak but pure light emanated from her body, forming some kind of connection with the storage ring.
"Want to grab the lotus seeds? Dreaming!" A trace of determination flashed in Qin Sihan's eyes.
The face of the Black Evil King changed: "No! She is going to destroy the lotus seeds!" His figure flashed, and he rushed towards the storage ring like a ghost. The purpose of his trip was the lotus seeds, and he must not let it be destroyed.
Qin Siyu and Qin Sihao also seized this fleeting opportunity, exploded with all their strength, and forced back their opponents.
However, Heisha's speed was too fast and he was about to grab the storage ring.
At this moment, a sudden change occurred!
A majestic voice that seemed to come from nine heavens away, like thunder from nine heavens, suddenly sounded between heaven and earth:
"Young boy, Heisha, dare to touch my things?"
